title: Vaultwarden
comment: Vaultwarden's DATA_FOLDER (db.sqlite3, rsa keys, attachments, sends, icon cache) carries as one tree into /config, which is the Daemonless image's DATA_FOLDER. The admin token and other settings come from the environment, not from the data folder; set them on the application. The image fronts vaultwarden with nginx on port 80. Proven 2026-09-29 on a stock FreeCORE-15.1-RC5 (222345a88d) appliance: a 14.4-RELEASE iocage jail's vaultwarden converted in one apply; db.sqlite3 and rsa_key.pem carried byte-identical (rsa key sha256 verified before and after), the web vault answered on the chosen host port. The source jail was not modified.
